introHtml: Wheat straw keychains offer a sustainable alternative to plastic, made from agricultural byproducts that would otherwise go to waste. These lightweight yet durable keychains are ideal for trade shows, retail promotions, or employee gifts where eco-conscious branding matters. The natural beige finish accepts full-color imprinting, giving you a custom look that aligns with green initiatives. Choose wheat straw to show your commitment to the environment without sacrificing quality or affordability.
